export const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z0-9.%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+.[a-zA-Z]{2,}$/;
export const ALPHANUMERIC_REGEX = /^[a-zA-ZÀ-ÿ]+[a-zA-ZÀ-ÿ0-9 '-.]*$/;
